training.selection: Maximize minimum signed expected-class threshold distance in absoluteuA. Among candidates within1pA of maximum, maximize minimum TRAINING absolute time margin; earliest exact tie wins. Validation never participates.

boundary: Current-equivalent unity-DC-gain optical/RX proxy, not optical watts or measured dynamics.
C=0 and tau=0 are ideal diagnostics, not physical candidates.
Native transistor energy and stress are independent electrical evidence; changing the offline optical tau does not rerun or physically couple the emitter.
Zero finite deterministic bit errors is not physical BER qualification.
Author-normalized S21 magnitude is not used to identify a transient or remove circuit/RX poles.

numerical_validation.limits: Analytic/subdivision tests verify numerical state propagation only; circuit halfstep and native baseline metrics are separate checks.

pure_delay_sensitivity.interpretation: A uniform100ps pure delay is absorbed by the shared0..8ns training search when its optimum remains inside the budget. This does not identify missing dispersive phase or a physical transient.
